# Rebuild APK properly - first ensure deps are installed and local.properties exists
cd /home/user/rork-app/expo

# Ensure deps are installed
if [ ! -f node_modules/react-native/package.json ]; then
    echo "Installing expo deps..."
    bun install 2>&1 | tail -5
fi

# Ensure local.properties exists
echo "sdk.dir=/opt/android-sdk" > android/local.properties

# Verify node can resolve react-native
node --print "require.resolve('react-native/package.json')" 2>&1 | head -3

# Start build in background with proper env
export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk
export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk
export JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(which java))))
export GRADLE_OPTS="-Xmx4096m -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4096m"
export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"

nohup bash -c '
  export ANDROID_HOME=/opt/android-sdk
  export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT=/opt/android-sdk
  export JAVA_HOME=$(dirname $(dirname $(readlink -f $(which java))))
  export GRADLE_OPTS="-Xmx4096m -Dorg.gradle.daemon=false -Dorg.gradle.jvmargs=-Xmx4096m"
  export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$PATH"
  cd /home/user/rork-app/expo/android
  ./gradlew assembleRelease --no-daemon --stacktrace 2>&1
' > /tmp/apk_build_final3.log 2>&1 &

BUILD_PID=$!
echo $BUILD_PID > /tmp/apk_build_final3_pid.txt
echo "APK build started: PID $BUILD_PID"
sleep 8
if kill -0 $BUILD_PID 2>/dev/null; then
    echo "Build is running"
    tail -5 /tmp/apk_build_final3.log
else
    echo "Build died!"
    tail -30 /tmp/apk_build_final3.log
fi
